items.title: Do you also feel that it's impossible to keep up with AI?
items.raw_excerpt: I have a tech background, I haven't been super active in coding or other things, but I still play with stuff a lot. And yet, in the past ~2 years, I often feel that it's pretty much impossible to keep up with the latest AI development (in particular regarding vibe coding), which in turns gives me less energy or determination to explore the latest thing. How do you feel about it? And did you find a solution to stay motivated to learn and get better at using AI?

items.title: Git 被换掉，LLM 被替代：AI 编码开始反噬传统工具链？
items.raw_excerpt: Anthropic 代码量暴涨，GitHub 密钥扫描又慢又贵，两家被迫改造系统。     作者丨 郑佳美     编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                         Git 已经支撑软件开发二十多年，Anthropic 却决定把它换掉。 为了让 Claude 持续生成的代码顺利进入开发流程，7 名工程师花了 5 个月，开发出版本控制系统 Scion，并将核心代码仓库迁移过去。 今年 5 月，Anthropic 每天平均合并约 2500 项代码变更，到 9 月已超过 3 万项，仅 CI 系统每天就要执行约 2500 万次代码检出。写代码的速度上来了，准备仓库、同步对象和查询历史却越来越费机器。 几乎同一时期，GitHub 用微调后的 ModernBERT 替换密钥扫描中的通用 LLM 判断。哥伦比亚大学与 Google DeepMind 等机构则通过 BTTF，把芯片仿真波形转换成 SQLite，让 Agent 使用 SQL 排查异常。 Sci

items.title: WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare
items.raw_excerpt: I wanted my humble Claude on mobile to access my WhatsApp messages but the only options I could find either required WhatsApp Business or an actual server to run Baileys on. I wanted to run it for free on ClaudeFlare and with my personal WhatsApp account, so I built this. Important feature - it connects to your Google account as well as WhatsApp to grab the names of all your WhatsApp contacts, otherwise you get only phone numbers for many of them and search doesn't work properly. This is a single user install because it's both gray area and very private - so point your agent at the repo and let it set things up.

This is a single user install because it's both gray area and very private - so point your agent at the repo and let it set things up.
